Mode: automated exploratory after PPG freeze; no blinded human validation
Case: Exact14 enriched pre20s windows, one per eligible onset regardless of warning
Control: Uniform time-stratified windows from the SAME recording with zero overlap of any eligible pre30s interval
Metric: Case candidate flag count minus median count of available same-record controls; long-gap/flat/jump indicators also retained
Inference: Descriptive only, repeated events clustered by recording; no p-value or causal interpretation
